object_description: very elongated low bar volume with a northern projecting wing
design_condition: The volume is placed parallel to the church at the village edge, enclosing a long courtyard while defining a new public centre and relating to the valley, roads, views, and neighbouring buildings.

positive.statement: The urban approach is clear, sober, readable, and rational.

position.rationale: The clear elongated bar and projecting wing establish a legible overall urban figure.

positive.statement: The elongated low volume strengthens the village centre by creating a strong boundary.

position.rationale: A continuous low linear bar is clearly visible across all calibrated views.

positive.statement: The extra-curricular wing acts as an attractor within the public space and can serve broader communal activities.

position.rationale: The distinct projecting wing is clearly identifiable at the northern end of the bar.

positive.statement: The simple structural assembly provides rational transmission of vertical and horizontal loads.

position.rationale: Repeated linear sampling suggests a regular assembly, without exposing structural members directly.

positive.statement: The roof geometry creates a thermal buffer zone during overheating.

position.rationale: The roof footprint and low-rise upper profile are clearly visible.

negative.statement: The extensions complicate the volume and diminish its initial plastic force.

position.rationale: The projecting northern wing visibly complicates the otherwise continuous bar volume.

negative.statement: The courtyard will be shaded and exposed to wind, while southern visual connections are lost.

position.rationale: The courtyard is approximated within the long bar footprint; shade and wind are not directly visible.

negative.statement: The form does not adequately resolve the site's public-space, route, view, and sunshine constraints.

position.target: public-space, route, view, and sunshine constraints
position.rationale: The building edge and adjacent open zone are visible, but individual site constraints are not separable.

negative.statement: The courtyard lacks permeable and planted surfaces, weakening its spatial and landscape quality.

position.rationale: The internal open-space location is inferred from the bar organization; planting and permeability are unrepresented.

negative.statement: Access from the parking area to the building is not convincing.

position.rationale: A plausible edge arrival zone is anchored beside the bar, without a distinguishable parking connection.

negative.statement: The topographical relationship between the different levels remains unresolved, giving the landscape project a two-dimensional character.

position.rationale: The sampled model shows a largely planar low volume, so level relationships remain approximate.

negative.statement: The games area is undersized and the water mirror would be better placed on the village square.

position.rationale: Open space is visible beside the bar, but games and water features are not distinguishable.

negative.statement: An additional vertical escape route is required for fire protection.

position.rationale: A possible secondary vertical route is anchored near the projecting wing, though no stair is visible.
